steps.content: Though it took quite some time, by using coordinated tactics, you successfully subdued most of the ducks, and now you finally stand before the last enemy duck.

steps.speaker: Sovereign Duck
steps.content: Quack quack, quack quack quack quack, quack quack quack quack quack! (Finally, you have come! The ultimate battle between ducks and humans was inevitable!)

steps.speaker: Sovereign Duck
steps.content: Quack quack quack quack quack—quack quack quack quack quack quack! (I was reborn and returned here! After enduring countless hardships to reach this place, I declare to the Bureau—the Ducks will decide their own fate from now on!)

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Actually, I've been wanting to ask this for a while... EMP, what novels did you show them?

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Ah, you know those novels with tons of tags and ridiculously long titles that go on forever? So it really is true—the longer the title, the stronger the power?
A quack of absolute fury interrupts your conversation. The duck facing you, seething with rage, pulls out its remaining photos and fans them out menacingly.

steps.speaker: Sovereign Duck
steps.content: Quack quack quack quack! Quack quack quack quack quack quack! (Don't underestimate us Ducks! I'll show you right now that heaven's mandate belongs to Ducks!!!)

steps.speaker: Sovereign Duck
steps.content: Quack quack quack quack, quack quack quack! (My turn, I play my cards!)
